decisions.reason: Confirmed unsupported representation/time inference: the published abstract effective decoder supplies no computational guarantee. Specified signed binary numerator/positive-denominator output with a fixed delimiter and charged complete output length, and clarified F1. The O(L) scan plus O(q^2) shortened division now follows directly; the numerical bounds, zero square root, conditioned normalization, series tails and fixed-degree algebraic bisection remain valid.

False positive: algorithm Definition step 2 expressly invokes the Pauli-coordinate construction in lem-qc-su2-balanced-commutator. That proof 1.1 chooses the smallest minimizing coordinate k, forms u=v/|v| and e=(u cross e_k)/|u cross e_k|, and defines a=sqrt(|v|/2)e, b=-sqrt(|v|/2)(u cross e); proof 2.1 sets V=exp(i a.sigma), W=exp(i b.sigma). This is a deterministic selection, not an appeal to bare existence. Its zero branch, norm bounds and error estimate apply at every recursive residual. No item edit.

Confirmed domain mismatch: the original theorem quantified real epsilon while its Given and the algorithm top-level interface permitted only rational tolerances. Preserved the real guarantee by specifying direct execution of the existing Compile(U,J) subroutine, with J selected by ideal exact-real comparisons. Proof 3.1 supplies a finite least J for every positive real tolerance; the levelwise error induction and resource recurrences are independent of its rationality. O(J+1) level-selection work is absorbed in O(3^J).

Confirmed false necessity claim: diag(1,mu) on the outer control multiplies C(W) to C(mu W), and the difference from C(CP_theta) is diag(0,CP_theta-mu W), whose norm equals the two-qubit error. Replaced must-compile-the-three-qubit-block with two sufficient routes, proved the corrected approximation explicitly, and retained the supplied seven-phase/ten-CNOT full-block factorization. Stated 0<epsilon<1/2 from the fixed-arity supplier and kept controlled access and phase-gate availability/cost caveats.
